Rubbish collected by Baltimore's Trash Wheel family

trash_items.Rd

Collection records from four Trash Wheels operating in Baltimore. Each row describes one rubbish category in one dumpster collection. Item counts are estimated using samples taken during collection.

Usage

trash_items

Format

A tibble with 6,951 rows and 7 variables:

id

Short identifier for the Trash Wheel.

name

Full name of the Trash Wheel.

dumpster

Collection number reported by the source. Numbers can repeat within a Trash Wheel. Use id, date, and dumpster together to distinguish collection records.

date

Date of collection, stored as a Date.

year

Year of collection.

trash_type

Category of rubbish counted.

count

Estimated number of items; missing when not reported.

Source

TidyTuesday: https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/main/data/2024/2024-03-05

Original data from Baltimore Healthy Harbor / Mr. Trash Wheel: https://www.mrtrashwheel.com/

Details

Missing counts do not mean zero. Collection histories and reporting coverage differ between Trash Wheels. The records should not be used directly to rank local pollution levels or machine performance.

Examples

head(trash_items)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 7
#>   id     name               dumpster date        year trash_type       count
#>   <chr>  <chr>                 <dbl> <date>     <dbl> <chr>            <dbl>
#> 1 mister Mister Trash Wheel        1 2014-05-16  2014 plastic_bottles   1450
#> 2 mister Mister Trash Wheel        1 2014-05-16  2014 polystyrene       1820
#> 3 mister Mister Trash Wheel        1 2014-05-16  2014 cigarette_butts 126000
#> 4 mister Mister Trash Wheel        1 2014-05-16  2014 glass_bottles       72
#> 5 mister Mister Trash Wheel        1 2014-05-16  2014 plastic_bags       584
#> 6 mister Mister Trash Wheel        1 2014-05-16  2014 wrappers          1162
